title: claude liberator reports a jq without regex support as 'not a JSON object'
body: liberators/claude.sh: _claude_home_paths (around line 428) and the settings-value check (around line 87) report any jq failure as 'is not a JSON object'. A jq built without regex support (oniguruma) fails on test() and is then misreported as a malformed settings file. Tell the two apart: probe jq's regex support once (eg jq -n '"a" | test("a")') and report 'cannot be checked: jq has no regex support' when it fails; keep 'is not a JSON object' for a file that parses as something else.
